svg.title: local-search benchmark: less context, lower latency, no search bill
svg.desc: A benchmark graphic showing 96.5 percent less visible agent context for three search results and comparing normalized tokens per result, median latency, result-depth fulfillment, and usage across local-search, Exa, Brave Search, Tavily, and Firecrawl.
svg.text: Less context. Lower latency. No search bill.

g.text: Same search task · command + JSON vs. browser screenshots used to perform the search
12 identical queries · 3- and 10-result depths · 24 sequential requests per provider · shared result schema
NORMALIZED TOKENS / RESULT · LOWER IS BETTER
‡ Firecrawl Hobby-plan equivalent: 48 credits × ($16 / 5,000) = $0.154; no PAYG.

svg.text: Source: public benchmark runner, July 21, 2026 · sequential requests · o200k_base · five-minute local cache.
